name: cruma-plugin
description: Cruma tunnel agent plugins: publish a dev server or a folder on a public URL from a coding agent with a shell on your own computer. One marketplace for any harness that reads this format, for example Claude Code or Codex.

plugins.name: cruma
plugins.description: Install the Cruma tunnel agent and publish a dev server or a folder on a public URL. Needs a coding agent with a shell on your own computer (for example Claude Code or Codex); where the environment does not allow installing it, such as claude.ai chat's sandbox, it explains that. A skill only: it asks before installing Cruma or connecting it to your agent.

plugins.name: cruma-local
plugins.description: Cruma with its local MCP server bundled: in any harness that loads plugin MCP servers, the plugin connects `cruma mcp` itself, with no extra setup. The plain `cruma` plugin is the skill-only one.

plugins.name: cruma-cloud
plugins.description: Optional: Cruma's hosted MCP server for your Cruma account (plan, account tunnels, sites). Asks you to sign in. Not needed for local tunnels.
